Definition: Peace — harmony, well-being and reconciliation with God, translating the wholeness of Hebrew shalom into the New Testament.
BiblicalUsage: Eirene flows from justification: 'having been justified by faith, we have peace with God.' Christ Himself 'is our peace,' leaving His own peace with His disciples on the night before the cross.
TheologicalSignificance: Eirene is not the world's fragile calm. It is Christ's own peace guarding hearts and minds — peace with God that becomes the peace of God.
